Azaadi khoon se jeeti aur savdhani se bachayi jaati hai.
Zyadatar log surakshit rehna chahte hain, azaad nahi.
Aazadi insaani samman ka aadharshila hai.
Khushi sacchi hai.
Chamakti khushi Bhagwan ki maujoodgi ka sanket hai.
Azaadi avashyak hai.
Azaadi astitva ka antim sach hai.
Khushi halki hai.
Azadi khud ki shakti hai.
Wander often, wonder always, azaad raho.
Anand mushkilon se nikal kar aata hai.
Khushi aapke zindagi ke nazariye ka parinam hai.
Wander karna matlab sach mein zinda rehna hai.
Aazadi sabse badi daulat hai.
Joy sabse badi buddhimatta hai.
Azadi bhagwan ki saans hai.
Khushi andar se aati hai.
Khushi shukraguzari ki khamosh prarthna hai.
Khushi ek adrishya kapda hai jo rooh ko pehnata hai.
Khushi achhai dekhna hai.
Khushi vishwas hai.
Khushi insaani vikas ka antim lakshya hai.
Khushi ek maksad hona hai.
Asli azaadi khud se azaad hona hai.
Joy achanak badhne ki bhavna hai.
Khushi khubsurti ko sarahna hai.
Liberty rooh ke liye wohi hai jo hawa shareer ke liye hai.
